ELIGIBILITY AND PARTICIPATION CONDITIONS Tender for Supply of Stationery and Printed Stationery Bidders are requested to note that participation in this tender is subject to t he following conditions. A bid that does not satisfy any of them may be trea ted as non-responsive and rejected. 1. Relevant experience. The bidder must have successfully execute d supply order(s) or purchase order(s) for stationery and printed stationery i tems only. Orders for any other category of goods shall not be considered f or this purpose. 2. Compulsory pre-bid meeting and sample inspection. The bid der must attend the pre-bid meeting scheduled on ______________________ (d ate, time and venue). Attendance is mandatory so that the bidder may insp ect the samples held by the Institute. Each bidder shall furnish a written dec laration that it has seen the samples and that, if declared L1, it will supply materials of the same specifications as the samples, or as approved on sam ple submission. 3. Delivery period. The entire contract material shall be supplied wi thin 45 (forty-five) days from the date of issue of the respective order. 4. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD). A bidder who is not the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the product shall submit an EMD of 2% (t wo per cent) along with the bid. 5. Electronic Performance Bank Guarantee (EPBG). The successf ul bidder shall furnish an EPBG equal to 5% (five per cent) of the contract a mount. 6. Years of experience. The bidder must have not less than 3 (three ) years of experience in the supply of stationery and printed stationery. 7. Past performance. The bidder must have past performance of no t less than 50% (fifty per cent) of the criterion prescribed in the tender docu ment, and such performance must relate exclusively to stationery and print ed stationery.
